step1_analysis.description: A Current Mode Logic (CML) D-latch with a self-biased tail current. It uses a lower differential pair for the clock to switch between track and hold modes, and an upper differential pair to sample the data input.

power_consumption.description: Total power dissipated by the latch

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V, Rload=500, Rbias=1k, the self-bias loop sets I_tail ~ 0.26 mA. Total current is ~0.26 mA. Power = 1.8V * 0.26mA = 0.47 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 1.45 W for the entire 4:1 MUX chip including clock distribution. A single latch consumes a small fraction of this.

propagation_delay.description: Time delay from data input crossing to output crossing during the track phase

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated delay of a CML stage in 1.8V with generic NPN models.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Delay depends heavily on the NPN model parameters (TF, CJC). Expected in the tens of picoseconds for a generic model.

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing = I_tail * R_load = 0.266 mA * 500 ohm = 133 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the self-bias loop and load resistors. The common mode will settle around 0.93V.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power, delay, and voltage swing of the CML D-latch. Missing resistor values from the extracted netlist have been populated to allow simulation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CML D-Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Generic NPN model since SKY130 NPNs are subcircuits and netlist uses Q instances
.model npn NPN(IS=1e-16 BF=100 VAF=50 CJC=10f CJE=20f TF=10p TR=1n)

* DUT (with added resistor values for simulation)
Q1 N4 N5 N3 npn
Q2 N12 N14 N3 npn
R1 Q_P N6 1k
Q3 N14 N14 N9 npn
Q4 VDD N1 Q_N npn
Q5 VDD Clk_N N14 npn
Q6 N6 N6 GND npn
Q7 N1 D_P N4 npn
Q8 N1 Q_P N12 npn
R2 Q_N N6 1k
R3 N7 VDD 500
R4 N1 VDD 500
Q9 N9 N6 GND npn
Q10 N7 D_N N4 npn
Q11 N7 Q_N N12 npn
Q12 N5 N5 N13 npn
Q13 VDD Clk_P N5 npn
Q14 N3 N6 GND npn
Q15 N13 N6 GND npn
Q16 VDD N7 Q_P npn

* Sources
VVDD VDD GND 1.8
* Clock: 1 GHz, 1.7V common mode to keep input transistors out of saturation
Vclk_p Clk_P GND dc 1.7 pulse(1.6 1.8 0 10p 10p 490p 1n)
Vclk_n Clk_N GND dc 1.7 pulse(1.8 1.6 0 10p 10p 490p 1n)
* Data: 500 MHz, transitions during the clock high (track) phase
Vd_p D_P GND dc 1.7 pulse(1.6 1.8 250p 10p 10p 0.99n 2n)
Vd_n D_N GND dc 1.7 pulse(1.8 1.6 250p 10p 10p 0.99n 2n)

.control
tran 5p 3n

* Power
meas tran I_vdd avg i(VVDD)

* Swing
meas tran V_QP_max max v(Q_P)
meas tran V_QP_min min v(Q_P)

* Delay (Data to Output during track phase)
* Output common mode settles around 0.93V with these resistor values
meas tran delay_rise trig v(D_P) val=1.7 rise=1 targ v(Q_P) val=0.93 rise=1
meas tran delay_fall trig v(D_P) val=1.7 fall=1 targ v(Q_P) val=0.93 fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
